Accepted, processing, verified or unknown mutations are reconciled and never blindly replayed.
A proven missing item requires a separate reviewed exact-ID write plan.
Lord God and Legendary Poet identities, ledgers and snapshots remain separate.
Long-form and Shorts/Clips remain separate manifests and evidence objects.
Editorial, preview, self-tested, canary-verified and batch-verified evidence levels are never collapsed.
PowerShell orchestrates one repository-owned provider implementation and does not duplicate provider rules.
Closed, unmerged, superseded or retired branches are evidence only and never become runtime sources again.
VK managed-community discovery uses groups.get(filter=moder, extended=1); exact project identity is verified separately.
Milovi Telegram has exactly one provider-mutation workflow and one durable state/concurrency namespace.
Milovi release/content authorization and fresh exact human execution authorization are separate; historical authorization never inherits.
